projects.title: Physical AI Safety
projects.subtitle: Trustworthy Vision-Language-Action models and embodied agents
projects.description: I study how embodied AI systems can perceive, reason, and act safely in changing environments. My research addresses robustness to environmental variation and adversarial inputs, alongside evaluation frameworks for trustworthy Vision-Language-Action models.
projects.image_alt: A camera observation image and a text language instruction feed a VLA model that produces robot actions.

projects.title: Adversarial Robustness & Generalization
projects.subtitle: Understanding failures and learning robust representations
projects.description: I investigate why models fail under adversarial perturbations and perceptual ambiguity, and how to make learning and predictions more reliable. My work connects the mechanisms of these failures with robust training, defense, calibration, and generalization across tasks and modalities.
projects.image_alt: Overview of asymmetric representation regularization for adversarial training.

projects.title: Reliable Vision-Language Models
projects.subtitle: Robust multimodal understanding and evaluation
projects.description: I develop training methods and benchmarks for vision-language models that understand visual and textual information reliably. My work brings together multimodal adversarial defense, language supervision, image-text alignment, and evaluation of when models should read or ignore text.
projects.image_alt: Overview of multimodal adversarial training with one-to-many image-text relationships.
points: Robust multimodal learning and adversarial defense

projects.title: Model Ownership & Content Protection
projects.subtitle: Protecting models and visual content from unauthorized use
projects.description: I develop methods to establish model ownership and protect visual content against unauthorized AI processing. My work explores fingerprints resilient to model merging, traceable watermarks for image editing, and content-aware perturbations that prevent unwanted colorization.
projects.image_alt: Semantic Color Naturalness Breaker adds a perturbation to a grayscale image, causing unauthorized AI colorization to produce unnatural colors.
points: Perception- and content-aware protection against colorization
